tooltip.essentialcraft5.ember_inlay.use.en: Combine with a weapon on an anvil to inlay it (%s levels; replaces any old inlay)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.ember_inlay.use.zh: 在铁砧上和武器合在一起就嵌进去（%s 级经验，旧的会被换掉）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.ember_inlay.cost.en: Each hit that lands costs %s MRU from storages you carry; no extra damage
tooltip.essentialcraft5.ember_inlay.cost.zh: 每打实一下扣 %s MRU（从身上的储存物品），不加伤害

tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.boss.en: Bosses aren't halved; they get Bisected for %s s instead (half damage dealt, half healing received); no effect on bosses immune to status effects
tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.boss.zh: 对 Boss 不减半，改为挂 %s 秒二分（造成的伤害、受到的治疗减半）；对状态效果免疫的 Boss 无效

tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.l.en: Aim at a creature within %s blocks to lock on: the strike follows it and stops 0.5 s before landing
tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.l.zh: 准星对着 %s 格内的生物时锁定它：打击点跟着它走，落下前 0.5 秒定住
